title: Mali FTS plan requirements and reported funding
license: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
limitations: National plan/year aggregates only; no actor, project or sector attribution.
Plan and non-plan funding remain separate; future usage years are not current funding.
Percent funded is publisher-rounded; requirements are not funding. Reported funding is not proof of disbursement or service delivery.
description: Mali FTS plan requirements and reported funding. National plan/year aggregates only; no actor, project or sector attribution.

definitions.grain: One plan, unspecified plan or other funding category per year as reported. Inspect plan identity before aggregation.
definitions.amounts: Reported USD. Requirements and funding are distinct. Missing amounts are unknown.
